headline: India is preparing a dedicated data center policy to protect consumers from higher electricity bills, a government minister said.
score_reason: Stays at the pool score: a national policy signal as local protests grow, but no content yet.
importance_line: Indian electricity customers and communities near planned sites are affected, but the policy's content and timing are not yet known.
summary: The Economic Times reports that Minister of State for IT Jitin Prasada said on Wednesday that India is preparing a data center policy to address electricity use and protect consumers from higher power bills, as local protests grow against planned Amazon and Google projects over water, electricity and environmental concerns.
notes: Only the opening paragraph of the article was readable; the rest was page navigation.
